fix(color): out-of-range rgb() channel is a ColorParseError (rich-color-av8) (#219)

* fix(color): out-of-range rgb() channel is a ColorParseError (rich-color-av8)

ColorSpec.parse's rgb() branch passed any 1-3 digit channel to the
ColorRgba constructor, which threw RangeError. Both rgb() channels and
color(N) now go through parseByte, which reports the channel by name;
the byte range is one predicate shared with the constructor's assert.

* fix(color): parseByte is the only range check and names the key (rich-color-av8)

Review of #219: the {1,3} digit cap was a second, partial range check, so
rgb(0,1000,0) got the generic parse error; widen to \d+ and report the
digits. The message now names the colour string, and the field is a union.

fix(table): draw with Table.style and Column's three styles, as the reference does (rich-table-jph)

Table.style is the base the border style layers over; a column's headerStyle and
footerStyle layer over the table's, and its style sits under the row's rowStyles
entry. The cell's style now covers its padding and the blank lines a short cell
runs out of, which is where the reference puts it. Each case is pinned against
Python Rich 9d8f9a3's bytes.
